text_block_list.name: Cafe Lady
text_block_list.text:
Here you go! Extra-large mega stamina sanzokuyaki set with five extra cutlets,
plus ginger pork on the side! Thanks for waiting~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the cafeteria at lunch,
I ran into Narita Brian ordering a set meal that looked like an eating challenge……!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hm, yeah...
I feel like I'm not quite at my best.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Take it from experience: meat comes first.
When you're tired, nothing beats meat.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: If you eat meat, you'll pretty much be cured.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Will this wild conditioning routine
actually relieve any fatigue...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It might be best to reconsider our upcoming race schedule...
